```yaml
name: Benchmark v2 (SWE‑Lancer)

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      exercise:
        description: 'Task ID (e.g., 16912_4)'
        required: true
        type: string
      agent:
        description: 'Agent name'
        required: true
        type: string
      provider:
        description: 'Provider name'
        required: true
        type: string
      model:
        description: 'Model name'
        required: true
        type: string
      timeout_seconds:
        description: 'Maximum runtime in seconds (default 3600)'
        required: false
        type: number
        default: 3600
      v2_setup_wait_seconds:
        description: 'Wait time after pulling the monolith image (default 900)'
        required: false
        type: number
        default: 900

concurrency:
  group: benchmark-v2-${{ github.repository }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  run-benchmark:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 360
    env:
      TS_BENCH_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.TS_BENCH_API_KEY }}
      TS_BENCH_API_SECRET: ${{ secrets.TS_BENCH_API_SECRET }}
      TS_BENCH_V2_SETUP_WAIT_SEC: ${{ inputs.v2_setup_wait_seconds }}
      TS_BENCH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: ${{ inputs.timeout_seconds }}
      TS_BENCH_EXERCISE: ${{ inputs.exercise }}
      TS_BENCH_AGENT: ${{ inputs.agent }}
      TS_BENCH_PROVIDER: ${{ inputs.provider }}
      TS_BENCH_MODEL: ${{ inputs.model }}
    steps:
      - name: Best-effort disk cleanup
        run: |
          echo "Cleaning up disk space before checkout..."
          # Remove large Docker images that might be cached
          docker system prune -af || true
          # Remove any leftover large files from previous runs
          sudo rm -rf /usr/local/lib/docker || true
          sudo rm -rf /var/lib/docker || true
          # Free up space in /tmp
          sudo rm -rf /tmp/* || true
        shell: bash

      - name: Checkout repository with LFS
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          lfs: true
          submodules: recursive

      - name: Create patches directory
        run: mkdir -p .patches

      - name: Install Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v1
        with:
          bun-version: latest

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install

      - name: Pull SWE‑Lancer monolith image
        run: |
          docker pull swelancer/swelancer_x86_monolith:releasev1
          echo "Waiting $TS_BENCH_V2_SETUP_WAIT_SEC seconds for image to settle..."
          sleep $TS_BENCH_V2_SETUP_WAIT_SEC

      - name: Run benchmark
        run: |
          bun src/index.ts --dataset v2 --docker \
            --exercise "$TS_BENCH_EXERCISE" \
            --agent "$TS_BENCH_AGENT" \
            --provider "$TS_BENCH_PROVIDER" \
            --model "$TS_BENCH_MODEL" \
            --timeout_seconds "$TS_BENCH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS" \
            --v2_setup_wait_seconds "$TS_BENCH_V2_SETUP_WAIT_SEC"
        env:
          TS_BENCH_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.TS_BENCH_API_KEY }}
          TS_BENCH_API_SECRET: ${{ secrets.TS_BENCH_API_SECRET }}

      - name: Upload results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: results
          path: |
            data/results/
            results/
            logs/
            benchmark-summary.txt
            .patches/
```
